description:
Foilboard Green is an Australian-manufactured rigid insulation
panel engineered from a fire-retardant expanded polystyrene (EPS) core laminated
on both sides with pure aluminum foil facings. Designed for roofs, external and
internal walls, retrofits, and suspended timber underfloors, it provides
a 3-in-1 thermal insulation, thermal break, and moisture vapor barrier. When
paired with adjacent reflective airspaces, it achieves total system R-values
from R1.6 to R4.0+ across 10mm to 50mm board thicknesses.
features:
3-in-1 insulation, thermal break, and moisture barrier in a single rigid
panel
Pure aluminum reflective facings reflect up to 97% of radiant heat
Fire-retardant expanded polystyrene (EPS) core

Achieves total system
R-values up to R4.0+ when paired with sealed airspaces

Fiber-free,
non-allergenic, non-carcinogenic, and non-itchy formulation

Impermeable to
water and will not sag, rot, or deteriorate over time

Anti-glare green
coating on one face for safe installation in bright sunlight

Extremely
lightweight, rigid, and fast to cut and fix on site

Group 1 fire hazard
classification compliant with AS 5637.1 / AS ISO 9705

Backed by a 25-year
manufacturer performance warranty

rag_summary:
Foilboard Green is a rigid Australian-made insulation board composed of a
fire-retardant EPS core laminated with pure aluminum foil facings on both sides.
Available in thicknesses from 10mm to 50mm (Total R-values from R1.6 to R4.0+
when paired with airspaces), it acts as a combined thermal insulator, thermal
break, and vapor barrier across walls, roofs, sheds, and suspended timber
floors. Fiber-free, moisture-impermeable, non-allergenic, and tested to Group 1
fire standards, it delivers lifetime thermal efficiency backed by a 25-year
performance warranty.

description:
Foilboard Green Joining Tape is a heavy-duty reinforced aluminum
foil tape engineered with an anti-glare green coating on its outer face to match
the green side of Foilboard Green panels. Coated with an aggressive,
cold-weather acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive, it creates a continuous
airtight and vapor-tight seal along panel butt joints and penetrations. Designed
specifically for outdoor, roof, and exposed wall applications, it prevents glare
blinding installers while maintaining thermal envelope continuity.

facings

joints
Airtight jointing prevents convective heat loss and air infiltration
Operating temperature resistance from -20°C to +80°C

Low Flammability Index

Smooth out all wrinkles and air bubbles to guarantee an airtight, vapor-proof

description:
Foilboard Spacer Blocks are pre-cut expanded polystyrene (EPS)
blocks designed to maintain a consistent, non-collapsible reflective airspace
between Foilboard insulation panels and external wall claddings or internal
linings. By establishing a guaranteed 20mm or 25mm still air cavity adjacent to
the reflective aluminum foil face, they ensure the assembly achieves its rated
total thermal R-value. Adhered or mechanically fixed between framing members,
they prevent panels from flexing, dislocating, or touching adjacent cladding
under wind loads.

description:
Foilboard Standard Fasteners are purpose-designed mechanical
fixings consisting of galvanized timber nails or screws paired with broad
plastic washer plates, engineered to secure Foilboard panels to timber framing
without puncturing or compressing the core. By spreading the fastening load
across a wide surface area, they prevent fastener pull-through under wind
suction and vibration. They provide a fast, secure fixing method for residential
timber-stud walls, raked ceilings, and shed framing.

Available in lengths tailored

Maintains panel rigidity and alignment

Foilboard Standard Tek Screws are self-drilling, zinc-plated

self-drilling drill-point tip pierces steel girts and studs without
pre-drilling, while the broad washer head distributes clamping force across the
panel face. Sized for 10mm to 25mm Foilboard sheets, they ensure rigid panel
fixing in steel-framed sheds, commercial drywall, and residential steel homes.

thick expanded polystyrene boards, while the enlarged washer prevents fastener
pull-through under high wind loads or ceiling gravity sag. They provide secure,
non-compressing mechanical attachment for high-R-value residential walls, raked
ceilings, and underfloor applications.

rag_summary:
Higgins Polyester Thermal &
Acoustic Batts are non-itchy, Australian-made insulation batts manufactured
from 100% polyester fiber containing up to 85% recycled PET plastic bottles.
Available in ceiling ratings from R2.5 to R5.0 and wall ratings from R1.5 to
R2.5 (widths 430mm and 580mm), they deliver durable thermal resistance and sound
absorption without slumping or degrading over time. Completely free of chemical
binders, resins, and formaldehyde, they are non-allergenic, Sensitive Choice
friendly, and backed by a 50-year manufacturer warranty.
